observations.sql: SELECT id,part,sort_key,amount,SUM(amount) OVER w AS total,COUNT(amount) OVER w AS known_values,GROUP_CONCAT(id) OVER w AS frame_ids_raw FROM samples WHERE part = ? WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY part ORDER BY sort_key) ORDER BY part,sort_key,id

SELECT id,part,sort_key,amount,SUM(amount) OVER w AS total,COUNT(amount) OVER w AS known_values,GROUP_CONCAT(id) OVER w AS frame_ids_raw FROM samples WHERE part = ? WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY part ORDER BY sort_key,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY part,sort_key,id

SELECT id,part,sort_key,amount,SUM(amount) OVER w AS total,COUNT(amount) OVER w AS known_values,GROUP_CONCAT(id) OVER w AS frame_ids_raw FROM samples WHERE part = ? WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY part ORDER BY sort_key RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY part,sort_key,id
